# Scadable

> Scadable is building the data and reasoning layer of the future. Its knowledge engine, Ontologic, builds a typed, provenance-backed model of a company's world and answers questions with the evidence attached, correct and cited or it says it does not know. Compliance is the first application: a compliance engine that fixes what it finds, starting with SOC 2.

Scadable identifies what does not meet a standard across a company's code, cloud and identity systems, fixes it (a pull request the company approves, a setting changed with sign-off, or a short guide to the person who has to act), reports with evidence, and prepares the company for an independent audit firm. Scadable does not issue audit reports; the audit firm does. Founders: Ali Rahbar (Founder and CEO) and Hossein Molavi (Co-founder and CTO). Backed by Velocity, the University of Waterloo startup incubator.

## The system: Ontologic

- [How Ontologic works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scadable/.github/main/docs/ontologic.md): what an ontology is, what Ontologic keeps (typed entities and relationships, timelines, trust levels, permissions, exact sets and counts, provenance), how it answers a question, measured reliability, and the reliability target.
- Measured on a fresh held-out test of 2,000 documents and 1,416 questions: all required evidence reached the model for 99.4% of literal and 79.1% of paraphrased questions; final answers correct for 95.3% and 69.4%; exact sets and counts right on 60 of 60. Not directly comparable with published search and memory benchmarks, which use different datasets and scoring.
- [ontologichq/kit](https://github.com/ontologichq/kit): Ontologic's gRPC API.
- [ontologichq/cli](https://github.com/ontologichq/cli): a command line client for Ontologic.
